title: One-Person Low-Sodium & Lighter Week on the Thermomix TM7
summary: This week uses fresh vegetables, pulses, whole grains, and lean proteins cooked in the Thermomix TM7 with salt-free herbs, garlic, and lemon instead of added salt. Portions are balanced with steamed meals and batch-cooked dinners that provide effortless next-day lunches alongside daily walking.

recipes.title: Warm Chickpea, Tomato and Spinach Salad with Lemon-Herb Dressing

steps.text: Place the peeled garlic clove in the mixing bowl, chop
steps.then: Scrape down the sides of the mixing bowl with the spatula.

steps.text: Add 10 g extra-virgin olive oil, sauté
Add 150 g halved cherry tomatoes, 150 g drained no-salt-added chickpeas, 1 tsp salt-free mixed dried herbs, and 1 pinch black pepper, warm through
Add 60 g baby spinach and 15 g freshly squeezed lemon juice, wilt gently
steps.then: Transfer to a serving bowl and serve warm.

tips: Serve with a slice of toasted whole-grain bread if desired.
recipes.why: This dish uses no-salt-added chickpeas, fresh spinach, and cherry tomatoes seasoned with lemon juice, garlic, and salt-free herbs instead of salt.
recipes.evidence: For adults, the World Health Organization recommends consuming less than 2,000 mg of sodium per day, which is equivalent to less than 5 g of salt [WHO — Sodium reduction (fact sheet)].

recipes.title: Steamed Salmon, Broccoli and Quinoa with Yogurt-Lemon Sauce

steps.text: Place the peeled garlic clove in the mixing bowl, chop
steps.then: Scrape down the sides of the mixing bowl with the spatula.

steps.text: Add 100 g plain 0% Greek yogurt, 20 g freshly squeezed lemon juice, 10 g extra-virgin olive oil, 0.5 tsp salt-free mixed dried herbs, and 1 pinch black pepper, mix
steps.then: Transfer the yogurt-lemon sauce to a small bowl and keep in the refrigerator until serving.

steps.text: Without washing the mixing bowl, pour 1200 g water into the mixing bowl, insert the simmering basket and weigh in 140 g rinsed quinoa. Place the Varoma dish in position and arrange 350 g broccoli florets inside, ensuring some steam vents remain uncovered. Line the Varoma tray with baking paper (leaving the side vents clear), place 260 g salmon fillets on the paper, and season the fillets with the remaining 0.5 tsp salt-free mixed dried herbs and 1 pinch black pepper. Insert the Varoma tray, close the Varoma lid, and steam
steps.then: Remove the Varoma carefully and lift out the simmering basket using the notch on the spatula. Plate one portion of the salmon, broccoli, and quinoa with half of the yogurt-lemon sauce; cool and refrigerate the second portion and sauce in airtight containers.

tips: Wetting and crumpling the baking paper before laying it on the Varoma tray makes it easier to shape while keeping the side vents open for steam circulation.
Keep the extra yogurt-lemon sauce in a separate small container so it can be drizzled fresh over the chilled second portion.
recipes.why: Steamed salmon, broccoli, and whole-grain quinoa are cooked without added salt and dressed with a fat-free Greek yogurt, lemon, and herb sauce.
recipes.evidence: Everyone older than 10 years of age should aim for at least 400 g of fruits and vegetables per day [WHO — Healthy diet (fact sheet)].

recipes.title: Chilled Salmon, Broccoli and Quinoa Bowl with Yogurt-Lemon Sauce

steps.text: Place 60 g reserved yogurt-lemon sauce in the clean mixing bowl, stir until smooth
steps.then: Scrape down the sides of the mixing bowl with the spatula.

steps.text: Arrange 30 g fresh baby spinach and 150 g chilled cooked quinoa in a serving bowl.
Flake 125 g chilled steamed salmon fillet into bite-sized pieces and place on top of the quinoa alongside 150 g chilled steamed broccoli florets.
steps.then: Drizzle with the yogurt-lemon sauce from the mixing bowl, season with 1 pinch of black pepper, and serve immediately.

tips: Take the reserved salmon and broccoli out of the refrigerator 10 minutes before assembling so the flavors are more pronounced.
If a warm bowl is preferred, place the quinoa, broccoli, and salmon in the mixing bowl with 20 g water and warm for 3 min/70°C/Reverse/speed spoon before plating over the fresh spinach.
recipes.why: This meal uses fresh baby spinach, whole-grain quinoa, broccoli, and fish with an herbed yogurt-lemon dressing and no added salt.
recipes.evidence: For adults, the World Health Organization recommends consuming less than 2000 mg of sodium per day, which is equivalent to less than 5 grams of salt [WHO — Sodium reduction (fact sheet)].

recipes.title: Hearty Red Lentil, Carrot and Zucchini Stew

steps.text: Place 100 g halved yellow onion, 2 garlic cloves, and 150 g carrot pieces in the mixing bowl, chop
steps.then: Scrape down the sides of the mixing bowl with the spatula.

steps.text: Add 15 g extra-virgin olive oil to the mixing bowl, sauté
Add 200 g zucchini pieces, 160 g rinsed dried lentils, 600 g low-sodium vegetable stock, 1 tsp salt-free mixed dried herbs, and 1/4 tsp ground black pepper to the mixing bowl, cook
Add 80 g halved cherry tomatoes to the mixing bowl, cook
steps.then: Serve one portion of the stew hot in a bowl, and transfer the second portion to an airtight container to cool and refrigerate.

tips: Lentils naturally thicken as they cool; when reheating the second portion, add a splash of water to loosen the consistency.
Rinse the dried lentils under cold water in the simmering basket before adding them to the mixing bowl.
recipes.why: Pulses like dried lentils and a generous mix of carrots, zucchini, and tomatoes are simmered in low-sodium vegetable stock with salt-free herbs.
recipes.evidence: Everyone older than 10 years of age should aim for at least 400 grams of fruits and vegetables per day and at least 25 grams of naturally-occurring dietary fibre [WHO — Healthy diet (fact sheet)].

recipes.title: Warm Lentil and Vegetable Stew with Toasted Whole-Grain Bread

ingredients.name: reserved lentil, carrot and zucchini stew
water
ingredients.note: to loosen the stew if thick

steps.text: Place the 350 g reserved lentil, carrot and zucchini stew and 50 g water into the mixing bowl, warm through
steps.then: Meanwhile, toast the slice of whole-grain bread until golden.

steps.text: Add a pinch of freshly ground black pepper to the mixing bowl, stir gently
steps.then: Pour the warm stew into a serving bowl using the spatula.

steps.text: Drizzle the stew with 5 ml extra-virgin olive oil and serve immediately alongside the toasted whole-grain bread.

tips: If the stew absorbed a lot of liquid overnight in the fridge, add an extra 20 g of water before reheating.
recipes.why: Combines a lentil, carrot, and zucchini stew seasoned with herbs instead of added salt with a slice of whole-grain bread.
recipes.evidence: On average, carbohydrates in the diet should come primarily from whole grains, vegetables, fruits, and pulses such as lentils, chickpeas, and beans [WHO — Healthy diet (fact sheet)].

recipes.title: Herbed Chicken Breast with Brown Rice and Steamed Carrots & Peppers

steps.text: Place 1 peeled garlic clove, 1 tsp salt-free mixed dried herbs, 1 pinch of black pepper, and 5 ml extra-virgin olive oil into the mixing bowl, chop
steps.then: Scrape down the sides of the mixing bowl with the spatula, then transfer the herb paste to a medium bowl.

steps.text: Add the 300 g chicken breast strips to the bowl with the herb paste and toss until evenly coated. Arrange the 160 g sliced carrots and 160 g bell pepper strips in the Varoma dish, place the Varoma tray on top, and arrange the herbed chicken strips on the tray, leaving a few steam vents uncovered.
Without washing the mixing bowl, pour 1200 g water into the mixing bowl, insert the simmering basket, weigh the 140 g rinsed brown rice into the basket, set the covered Varoma in place, and steam
steps.then: Carefully remove the Varoma and use the notch on the spatula to lift out the simmering basket.

steps.text: Divide the cooked brown rice, steamed carrots, bell peppers, and herbed chicken into two equal portions. Drizzle the first portion with 10 ml extra-virgin olive oil and 15 ml lemon juice to serve warm, and pack the second portion into an airtight container to refrigerate.

tips: When arranging the chicken and vegetables in the Varoma, keep a few holes in the centre unobstructed so the steam circulates evenly.
Let the second portion cool completely before sealing and refrigerating.
recipes.why: Uses steamed skinless chicken breast, brown rice, carrots, and bell peppers seasoned with garlic, lemon juice, and salt-free herbs instead of salt.
recipes.evidence: For adults on average, the World Health Organization recommends less than 2000 mg/day of sodium (equivalent to less than 5 g/day salt), and sodium intake can be reduced by cooking with little or no added salt and using herbs and spices to flavour food rather than salt [WHO — Sodium reduction (fact sheet)].

recipes.title: Herbed Chicken and Brown Rice Bowl with Fresh Spinach

ingredients.name: leftover steamed herbed chicken, brown rice, carrots and bell peppers
ingredients.note: from Wednesday dinner, cut into bite-sized pieces

steps.text: Place the leftover brown rice, steamed carrots, bell peppers, chicken pieces, and 30 g of water into the mixing bowl, then warm gently
steps.then: Scrape down the sides of the mixing bowl with the spatula.

steps.text: Add 60 g of fresh baby spinach, 10 ml of extra-virgin olive oil, the juice of half a lemon, and a pinch of black pepper to the mixing bowl, then toss to wilt the leaves slightly
steps.then: Check that the spinach is lightly wilted and the mixture is evenly coated.

steps.text: Transfer the warm chicken, brown rice, and spinach mixture into a serving bowl and serve immediately

tips: If preferred cold as a salad, skip the heating step and toss all ingredients directly in a bowl with the lemon juice and olive oil.
recipes.why: This dish pairs whole-grain brown rice, lean skinless chicken breast, and fresh vegetables like spinach, carrots, and peppers with lemon juice and herbs instead of added salt.
recipes.evidence: On average, everyone older than 10 years of age should aim for at least 400 grams of fruits and vegetables per day [WHO — Healthy diet (fact sheet)].

recipes.title: Steamed Cod with Cannellini Bean, Tomato and Garlic Ragout

steps.text: Place 1 peeled garlic clove and 50 g of halved yellow onion in the mixing bowl, then chop
steps.then: Scrape down the sides of the mixing bowl with the spatula.

steps.text: Add 10 ml of extra-virgin olive oil to the mixing bowl and sauté

Add 150 g of halved cherry tomatoes, 150 g of drained no-salt-added cannellini beans, 100 ml of low-sodium vegetable stock, 0.5 tsp of salt-free mixed dried herbs, and a pinch of black pepper to the mixing bowl. Line the Varoma tray with wetted, crumpled baking paper, leaving the side vents clear; place the 150 g cod fillet on the paper, season with the remaining 0.5 tsp of salt-free mixed dried herbs, position the Varoma on top, and cook
steps.then: Carefully remove the Varoma and check that the cod flakes easily.

steps.text: Spoon the warm cannellini bean and tomato ragout into a deep plate, top with the steamed cod fillet, and serve with the lemon wedges on the side

tips: Wetting and crumpling the baking paper makes it fit the Varoma tray easily while keeping the fish juices contained; always leave some vents uncovered so steam circulates properly.
recipes.why: Steamed cod and no-salt-added cannellini beans provide lean fish and plant protein, flavored with garlic, tomatoes, and salt-free herbs rather than table salt.
recipes.evidence: For adults, the World Health Organization recommends less than 2,000 mg of sodium per day, which is equivalent to less than 5 g of salt per day, on average [WHO — Sodium reduction (fact sheet)].

recipes.title: Low-Sodium Turkey, Avocado and Spinach Whole-Grain Sandwich with Carrot-Apple Slaw

steps.text: Place the 100 g carrot pieces, 80 g apple pieces, 10 g lemon juice, 10 g extra-virgin olive oil, and 1 pinch of black pepper in the mixing bowl, shred
steps.then: Scrape down the sides of the mixing bowl with the spatula and transfer the carrot-apple slaw to a serving plate.

steps.text: Place the 50 g avocado in the mixing bowl, mash
steps.then: Scrape down the sides with the spatula.

steps.text: Spread the mashed avocado evenly onto one of the 2 slices of whole-grain bread, layer with the 80 g low-sodium turkey breast slices and 30 g baby spinach, top with the second slice of bread, and serve alongside the carrot-apple slaw.

tips: Toast the whole-grain bread slices lightly before assembling the sandwich for extra crunch.
Add a pinch of salt-free mixed dried herbs to the mashed avocado for an extra boost of flavour.
recipes.why: This lunch uses low-sodium turkey breast, whole-grain bread, avocado, and raw carrot, apple, and spinach dressed with lemon juice and olive oil with no added salt.
recipes.evidence: For adults, on average, the World Health Organization recommends consuming less than 2,000 mg of sodium per day, which is equivalent to less than 5 g of salt [WHO — Sodium reduction (fact sheet)].

recipes.title: Whole-Wheat Pasta with Creamy Ricotta, Zucchini and Cherry Tomatoes

ingredients.name: whole-wheat pasta
ingredients.note: short shapes such as penne or fusilli

steps.text: Place 1200 g water in the mixing bowl, heat
Add the 160 g whole-wheat pasta through the lid opening, cook without the measuring cup
steps.then: Reserve 50 g of the pasta cooking water in a small cup, then drain the pasta using the simmering basket and set aside in a large warm bowl.

steps.text: Empty and dry the mixing bowl, place the 2 peeled garlic cloves inside, chop
steps.then: Scrape down the sides of the mixing bowl with the spatula.

steps.text: Add the 15 g extra-virgin olive oil and 300 g diced zucchini to the mixing bowl, sauté
Add the 200 g halved cherry tomatoes, 1 tsp salt-free mixed dried herbs, and 1 pinch of black pepper to the mixing bowl, cook
Add the 100 g ricotta, 60 g baby spinach, and the 50 g reserved cooking water to the mixing bowl, warm and mix
steps.then: Pour the creamy zucchini, tomato, and ricotta sauce over the drained whole-wheat pasta, toss gently with the spatula, serve one portion warm, and store the second portion in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

tips: Reserving a splash of the starchy pasta water helps the ricotta melt into a smooth, glossy sauce without needing extra oil or cream.
When reheating the refrigerated second portion, add a tablespoon of water before warming to keep the sauce creamy.
recipes.why: Whole-wheat pasta is paired with zucchini, cherry tomatoes, baby spinach, ricotta, garlic, and salt-free herbs with no added salt.
recipes.evidence: Everyone older than 10 years of age should, on average, aim for at least 400 grams of fruits and vegetables per day and at least 25 grams of naturally-occurring dietary fibre from foods such as whole grains, vegetables, fruits, and pulses [WHO — Healthy diet (fact sheet)].

recipes.title: Ricotta, Zucchini and Tomato Whole-Wheat Pasta

ingredients.name: leftover whole-wheat pasta with ricotta, zucchini and cherry tomatoes

steps.text: Place the 350 g leftover whole-wheat pasta with ricotta, zucchini and cherry tomatoes and 30 g water in the mixing bowl, warm through
steps.then: Scrape down the sides of the mixing bowl with the spatula.

steps.text: Add the 40 g baby spinach to the mixing bowl, wilt gently
steps.then: Check that the pasta is piping hot and the spinach is tender.

steps.text: Transfer to a warm plate, drizzle with 5 ml extra-virgin olive oil and season with 1 pinch of black pepper before serving.

tips: Adding a splash of water before reheating loosens the ricotta sauce so it coats the whole-wheat pasta evenly without drying out.
recipes.why: Whole-wheat pasta and fresh baby spinach provide whole grains and vegetables with no added salt, seasoned with black pepper and extra-virgin olive oil.
recipes.evidence: For most people, unrefined carbohydrates from whole grains, vegetables, fruits and pulses should represent approximately 45–75% of total daily energy [WHO — Healthy diet (fact sheet)].

recipes.title: Browned Tofu and Bell Pepper Stir-Fry with Steamed Broccoli and Quinoa

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.note: drained, patted dry and cut into 2 cm cubes

ingredients.name: bell peppers
ingredients.note: deseeded and cut into 2 cm pieces

steps.text: Place 1200 g water in the mixing bowl. Insert the simmering basket and weigh in 120 g rinsed quinoa. Place the Varoma dish in position, weigh in 300 g broccoli florets, secure the Varoma lid and steam
steps.then: Set the Varoma aside, use the spatula to remove the simmering basket, and empty the cooking water from the mixing bowl. Keep the quinoa and broccoli warm.

steps.text: Place 1 peeled garlic clove and 80 g halved yellow onion in the empty mixing bowl, chop
steps.then: Scrape down the sides of the mixing bowl with the spatula.

steps.text: Add 15 ml extra-virgin olive oil, 250 g cubed firm tofu, 200 g bell pepper pieces, 1 tsp salt-free mixed dried herbs and 1 pinch of black pepper to the mixing bowl, sear
steps.then: Pour the juice of 0.5 lemon over the browned tofu and peppers and stir gently with the spatula.

steps.text: Divide the cooked quinoa, steamed broccoli and browned tofu stir-fry into 2 equal portions: serve 1 portion hot for dinner and transfer the remaining 1 portion to an airtight container, once cooled, and refrigerate for Sunday lunch.

tips: Patting the firm tofu thoroughly dry with kitchen paper before cutting helps it brown cleanly in the mixing bowl.
Keep the leftover portion of tofu, broccoli and quinoa in a sealed container in the refrigerator for Sunday's lunch bowl.
recipes.why: Plant-based protein from firm tofu is paired with whole-grain quinoa, broccoli and bell peppers, flavoured with lemon and salt-free herbs instead of salt.
recipes.evidence: For adults, the World Health Organization recommends consuming less than 2000 mg of sodium per day, which is equivalent to less than 5 g of salt per day [WHO — Sodium reduction (fact sheet)].

recipes.title: Tofu, Broccoli and Quinoa Power Bowl with Walnuts

ingredients.name: leftover browned tofu, bell pepper, broccoli, and quinoa

steps.text: Place 20 g unsalted walnuts in the mixing bowl and chop
steps.then: Transfer to a serving bowl and set aside.

steps.text: Place the 350 g leftover browned tofu, bell pepper, broccoli, and quinoa along with 20 g water in the mixing bowl, then warm through
steps.then: Use the spatula to transfer the warm mixture into the serving bowl.

steps.text: Drizzle with 5 ml extra-virgin olive oil and the juice of 0.5 lemon, top with the chopped walnuts and 1 pinch black pepper, and toss gently before serving
steps.then: Serve immediately.

tips: This bowl can also be enjoyed cold straight from the fridge as a quick salad with the lemon juice, olive oil, and walnuts.
recipes.why: Plant-based protein from tofu and unsalted walnuts paired with whole-grain quinoa and broccoli, seasoned with lemon and black pepper with no added salt.
recipes.evidence: For adults, the World Health Organization recommends consuming less than 2,000 mg of sodium per day, which is equivalent to less than 5 grams of salt [WHO — Sodium reduction (fact sheet)].

recipes.title: Steamed Vegetable Frittata with Herbed Tomato Salad

steps.text: Place 1 peeled garlic clove and 80 g bell pepper pieces in the mixing bowl, then chop
steps.then: Scrape down the sides of the mixing bowl with the spatula.

steps.text: Add 2 eggs, 50 g ricotta, 0.5 tsp salt-free mixed dried herbs, and 1 pinch black pepper to the mixing bowl, then mix
steps.then: Line the Varoma tray with a sheet of wetted, wrung-out baking paper, scatter 40 g baby spinach leaves over the paper, and pour the egg mixture on top.

steps.text: Rinse the mixing bowl, pour 500 g water into the bowl, set the Varoma with the tray in position, and steam
steps.then: Carefully remove the Varoma lid away from your face to avoid escaping steam.

steps.text: While the frittata steams, toss 120 g halved cherry tomatoes in a serving bowl with 5 ml extra-virgin olive oil, 5 ml apple cider vinegar, and the remaining 0.5 tsp salt-free mixed dried herbs
steps.then: Slide the steamed frittata onto a plate and serve alongside the herbed tomato salad.

tips: Wetting and crumpling the baking paper before lining the Varoma tray helps it mould neatly to the tray while keeping the steam vents along the edges unobstructed.
recipes.why: Steamed rather than fried, combining eggs, ricotta, and 240 g of vegetables flavoured with garlic, vinegar, and salt-free herbs.
recipes.evidence: Everyone older than 10 years of age should aim for at least 400 grams of fruits and vegetables per day as part of a healthy diet [WHO — Healthy diet (fact sheet)].

movement: Mon: Take a 25-minute brisk walk around your neighborhood after lunch.
Tue: Do a 20-minute walk and 15 minutes of light bodyweight strength exercises (such as wall push-ups and chair squats).
Wed: Walk briskly for 30 minutes, choosing a route with a few gentle hills or stairs.
Thu: Take two 15-minute walks—one in the morning and one before dinner.
Fri: Do 20 minutes of light strength exercises using household items or bodyweight, followed by a 15-minute easy walk.
Sat: Enjoy a longer 35-minute brisk walk in a local park or scenic area.
Sun: Take a relaxed 25-minute walk and spend 10 minutes stretching your legs and back.
